17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 2300 West Huron Street, Chicago, 1L

Proposed Zoning: RM-6 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 3,457.32 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change to divide the subject zoning lot
into two (2) independent zoning lots. The property at 2300 W. Huron will
remain improved with the existing three-story, ten (10) unit residential
building. The height and footprint of the existing three-story residential
building will remain without change and will not be supported by off-street
parking. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE of the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to decrease the off-
street parking requirement for a Transit Served Location to zero parking
spaces, reduce the front, rear, and west side setbacks to or below zero, and
all relief necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the
attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 12,519.32 square feet (3.62 FAR) (existing)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 345.73 square feet per D.U.
(10 existing residential units)

(C) *The amount of off-street parking: 0 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Western Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to decrease the
off-street parking requirement for a Transit Served Location to zero parking spaces.

(@) — *Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 0 feet (existing to remain)

b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 0 feet (existing to remain)
East Side: 0 feet (existing to remain)
c. Rear Setback: 10 feet-5.25 inches (existing to remain)

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B , the Applicant is seeking to reduce the front setback,
reduce the rear, and reduce the west side setback.

(E) Building Height: 34 feet-7 inches (existing to remain)
